Through talks, media, convenings, learning experiences, and industry-leading storytelling, TED influences how millions around the world think, learn, and engage. About TED Brand Creative: The TED Brand Creative team is passionate about TEDs content and the prospect of creating a stronger platform to enable the exchange of ideas worldwide. Were endlessly curious. As part of the larger Media and Curation team, were focused on delivering the best experiences possible across a wide range of platforms our annual conferences, our editorial channels, our global distribution efforts, new content formats, and much more. Job Description As a multi-disciplined creative, you are a highly conceptual visual thinker and detailed in the execution of ideas, from cradle to completion. You're capable of creating gorgeous, innovative work, but you can think strategically, scaling ideas holistically across a diverse range of applications and platforms. You know how to build a brand system and how to break new ground within one. You've created work for both digital and print, and you understand what it takes to bring a design all the way through to production. You have a strong command of typography, color, and composition, and you integrate photography and visual storytelling naturally into your work. TED is a seriously collaborative environment you're ready to lead as the visionary on a project and assist a teammate in the execution of theirs. No task is too big or too small. You are committed to the health of the team as a whole. This position reports to the Design Director. Role and responsibilities: Fluently work within TED Brand Creative's concept-focused and strategic-minded design process Create impactful and thoughtful concepts, experiences, designs, and identities that bring the TED brand and its numerous products and initiatives to life across a wide range of touchpoints Design at an extremely high level and provide a strong creative point of view Concept and execute identities and brand systems for original video series, podcasts, conferences, and initiatives Extend design systems for events to cover environmental graphics, books, stage design, digital marketing, social media, screen environments, templated signage, merch and more Create original artworks for TED's editorial channels Own print production from layout through vendor handoff including large-format signage, conference materials, and print-ready files Present designs and concepts with clarity and conviction Seek out, receive, and apply feedback in order to push your and the teams work further and know how to provide constructive feedback to other team members Qualifications We're looking for someone with: 3+ years of graphic design experience NYC-based preferred. TED is headquartered in New York City. A broad range of interests. You live and breathe graphic design but bring other skills to the table illustration, motion, photography, 3D, other creative endeavors valued Expert fluency in Adobe Creative Cloud, with working knowledge of designing for print InDesign and Photoshop especially. You can prep files and work with vendors to get the output right. If you're still building this print muscle, youre able to learn fast and own it Expertise in Figma is a must and working knowledge of digital design systems a significant plus Experience designing marketing assets email, social, display, web is also a plus Strong organizational skills, from concept through delivery of mechanicals Flexibility. TED is a fast-paced environment, and we jump quickly from project to project. You can keep up and thrive off the energy of working on something new. A deeply curious mind. You are culturally engaged and proactively exploring new technologies and trends within the design world Additional Information Salary Range: $75,000.00 - $83,000.00 Benefits : Competitive base salary commensurate with experience Flexible/hybrid work Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits Flexible paid time off and holiday schedule 401(k) with company match TED Conferences LLC is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We invite all qualified candidates to apply online with their resume and cover letter.
